rv.q: Community is described on The Rep’s web site as "a coming of age comedy", which it isn’t really.

But the two girls’ characters, especially that of Zoya, do seem to veer into caricature and so one never truly empathises with their plights, the outcome, perhaps, of exaggerated direction from Alice Chambers.
Birmingham Rep’s Community is a lively and heartfelt exploration of what it truly means to belong.

cn.t: Critics find this Birmingham community centre tale heartfelt but familiar, praising its lively performances and exploration of belonging while noting it relies on well-worn tropes about mismatched characters learning from each other.
